scope_interpretation.fit_numerical_integrity: all four 2018 fits and predictions pass the frozen numerical checks; this is not scientific/forecast qualification
scope_interpretation.empirical_scope: one held-out retrospective election cycle (2018/A), 30 supported ordinary D/R Senate races; no conclusion about multi-cycle performance or adoption
scope_interpretation.tail_scope: all 2018 observed win outcomes have nonzero empirical posterior mass; this does not resolve constant/rare winner tails in other cycles, and the suite keeps those limitations explicit
scope_interpretation.predictive_law: for each posterior draw, 5 replicates share a new cycle shock across all 30 races and use a race-specific Student-t5 shock; this was reconstructed from the pinned model design, posterior bank, and stored shocks

H0.joint_row_identity: Each of 5 replicate logits per retained posterior row equals offset + beta design + tau_cycle * one shared cycle draw across all races + tau_race * race-specific Student-t draw; race order exactly equals frozen 2018 target frame.
